intro: These records show what was known when each transaction occurred. Check orders and license management for current balances and license status.
admin.explanation: “Accepted by delivery channel” does not mean the user read the message. External delivery may retry, while an in-app notification is created only once. Retrying only requeues the notification; it does not repeat the transaction or change the license.
retry.title: Schedule notification delivery again
retry.success: Notification requeued; delivery is not yet confirmed.
retry.summary: Order: {order}; only the notification will be sent again.
event.order_paid: Payment confirmed; license was active at the time
event.payment_review: Payment is being reviewed; do not pay again
error.channel_unconfigured: Transaction notification channel is not configured
error.unknown_delivery: Delivery error. Check the configuration and channel.
error.permission_denied: You do not have this permission.
error.retry_not_allowed: Only failed or blocked notifications can be requeued. Refresh the list.
error.retry_confirmation_required: Confirm that you want to requeue this notification.
error.idempotency_conflict: This request ID was used for another reason. Review the request.
error.generic: The operation could not be completed. Refresh and review.
label.attempts: {count, plural, =0 {# attempts} one {# attempt} other {# attempts}}
label.license_revoked: The associated license was revoked for this refund.
page.admin: Page {page} of {count, plural, =0 {# records} one {# record} other {# records}}
page.user: Page {page}; {count, plural, =0 {# unread} one {# unread} other {# unread}}
